cohort: 420 mothers aged 16-50 years with newborns (2-10 weeks after delivery) in Najran City, Saudi Arabia
finding: The prevalence of PPD was high (66.7%), with significant associations found between higher EPDS scores and unemployment, younger age, caesarean delivery, mental illness, lack of adequate family support, and higher stress levels.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was significantly associated with higher EPDS scores, suggesting an increased risk of PPD.
